definitions.full: H1770. dig [ דִּיג דוג, ] verb denominative fish for, catch — Qal Perfect 3masculine plural suffix וְדִיגוּם consecutive Jer 16:16 (but as Qal dubious Ges § 73 . 2; Sta § 160 b. 2 regards as Hiph`il (abbreviated ), Nö ZMG. 1883, 540 conjecture Pi`el )
